safety.title: Built for young athletes from day one
safety.body: Most of our users are young athletes, so these are rules of the system, not settings.

consent.title: Parents consent first
consent.copy: A profile of a player under 20 cannot be shown to the public until a parent consents.

private.title: Photos and birth dates stay private
private.copy: Athlete photos open through short-lived links after a permission check. Public profiles show age, never the birth date.

health.title: No health data kept
health.copy: Before a session we ask "Does anything hurt right now?" so a player stops if it does. The answer is never stored.

delete.title: Delete it yourself
delete.copy: Delete all athlete data from the profile page, as Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act allows.

levels.title: Every number shows its source
levels.body: Card data comes in three levels, so you can see at a glance how far to trust it. A value nobody has assessed shows as "—", never a guess.

who.q: Who can see my child's data?
who.a: A profile stays private until you choose to open it. For players under 20, a parent must consent first. Once open, the public sees name, team, position, age and results, but not the birth date.

rating.q: Where does Power Rating come from?
rating.a: Only from results confirmed by the tournament organizer. A player without results gets a STARTER card, which says plainly that nothing is verified yet.

training.q: How reliable are the training programmes?
training.a: They are drawn from research on injury prevention and skill development in youth football, with a source for every drill. They are still drafts awaiting review by a licensed coach.

delete.q: How do I delete the data?
delete.a: Open the profile page with your child's account and choose to delete athlete data. Everything about the athlete is erased and a request to close the account goes to our team.
